star_peak_scale.unit: measured / predicted star peak above the pedestal, median over stars
star_peak_scale.note: [tests model.peak_counts: t and 1/g scaling at star peaks] stars at least 50.0 counts above the sky in A and predicted below 0.9 x linear_to_at_least.  Passes within 10%.  one list of 8033 isolated stars (spatial.stars {'nsigma': 5.0, 'background': 31, 'isolation': 5}) on the mean of the cell D subs; peaks by stats.peaks, radius 1, on raw subs realigned by whole-pixel shifts per 4x4 tile; a star's peak in a cell is the median over its subs, and it is clipped there if that median is 4095.  Predictions from each star's peak in cell A, through model.peak_counts with 15's cold g and pedestal and 17's F_sky per cell
